diagnosis: The planner was compiled from an earlier thin-frontier state, but by execution time the CURRENT compact frontier had replenished to 12 claimable candidates. The metabolism 10-minute window contained 0 recent worker beacons, so target_claimable resolved to the absolute floor of 8. Current claimable supply therefore exceeded target by 4. Materializing successor jobs would be filler and duplicate already-grounded routes.
intervention: Reopened the exact 12 evidence-backed derived jobs from the planner claim, recomputed the current metabolism target from the complete non-truncated beacon tree, verified current compact-frontier count=12 against target=8, and suppressed planner self-materialization. No duplicate successor was created.
